hero_kpi_rationale: The contract backlog reflects visibility into future revenues in a cyclical sector and is a key indicator of CMB.TECH's contractual health and sustainable growth strategy

kpis.name: Contract Backlog
kpis.explanation: Total value of signed maritime transport contracts yet to be executed.
kpis.description: The backlog increased by $304 million due to five 5-year Capesize charters and one 3-year CSOV contract.
kpis.signal: Backlog sharply up due to new long-term charters.

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, a measure of operational performance.
kpis.description: EBITDA reached $322.1 million in Q4 2025, compared to $180.4 million a year earlier.
kpis.signal: EBITDA strongly growing due to favorable market conditions.

kpis.name: Net Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net profit amounted to $90.1 million in Q4 2025, compared to $93.1 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in profit despite higher EBITDA.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated from maritime shipping activities.
kpis.description: Q4 2025 revenue reached $589.1 million, compared to $226.0 million in 2024.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount distributed to shareholders per share.
kpis.description: An interim dividend of $0.16 per share was declared.

kpis.name: Gain on Asset Sales
kpis.explanation: Net gain realized from the sale of vessels at high prices.
kpis.description: Net gain on asset sales amounted to $71.1 million in Q4 2025.
kpis.signal: Increased gains on vessel sales, reflecting high prices.

kpis.name: Vessel Sales
kpis.explanation: Number of VLCCs sold at high prices.
kpis.description: CMB.TECH sold 8 older VLCCs at very high prices, strengthening its cash position.

kpis.name: Investment in ammonia supply chain
kpis.explanation: Strategic investment in green ammonia production in China.
kpis.description: CMB.TECH is investing in the ammonia supply chain in China to strengthen its energy transition.
kpis.signal: Early positioning in maritime green fuels.

risks.title: Dependence on a few large customers
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the first section of business risks, strong language ("substantial loss"), stable but critical risk, key category for commercial sustainability.

risks.title: Increased competition on freight rates
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the text, repeated language on rate volatility, trend toward downward pressure, high weight in the context of overcapacity.

risks.title: Cyberattacks on critical systems
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of digital security risks, alert language ("disrupt our business"), rising risk with digitalization, strategic category.

risks.title: Increased environmental regulation (IMO, EU ETS)
risks.score_rationale: Repeated and detailed presence, strong language ("increase our costs", "adversely affect"), clearly rising trend, major impact on costs and compliance.

risks.title: Geopolitical disruptions in strategic straits
risks.score_rationale: Specific details on the Strait of Hormuz, Red Sea, alarmist language ("materially increased risks", "effective traffic interruption"), risk sharply rising, direct impact on operations.

risks.title: Dependence on alternative fuel technologies
risks.score_rationale: Mention of uncertainties around hydrogen, ammonia, and future engines, cautious but concerned language, growing technological risk, strategic impact.

risks.title: Compliance with international sanctions
risks.score_rationale: Multiple references to sanctions on Russia, 'shadow fleets', strict language on penalty risks, trend toward increasing regulation, high weight.

risks.title: Shortage of qualified maritime personnel
risks.score_rationale: Mention of reliance on key personnel and qualified seafarers, moderate but recurring language, stable risk, limited but real operational impact.

ai_positioning.summary: CMB.TECH does not mention any strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in its recent filings. The company focuses on maritime energy transition, green fuels, and fleet optimization through operational means.
evidence: No mention of AI in the Q4 2025 earnings release
No reference to AI tools for fleet management or predictive maintenance
Stated focus on green ammonia and sustainable fuels
